annotations.title: Fix the speaker of subtitle lines

description: For a multi_speaker localize_video job that has not started voicing yet (e.g. WaitingSpeakerVoices): move lines to another speaker. Send only the lines to change; a new speaker number (e.g. "2" when only 0 and 1 exist) adds a character. Applies to every language of the same video that has not started voicing. The job does not continue: call set_speaker_voices afterwards (include a voice for any new speaker).

job_guid.description: job_guid of one language from localize_video.

speaker.description: Speaker number, e.g. "0", "1", or a new one.

name: set_speaker_lines
title: Fix the speaker of subtitle lines
